ev.q: The Nevada case is the first identified case of a Neisseria gonorrhoeae isolate harboring the mosaic penA 60 allele reported in the United States.
Its MIC is the highest for ceftriaxone observed since GISP began monitoring
No other isolates had MICs as high as those for the isolate in the Nevada case
This SNHD gonococcal isolate was collected from an HIV-negative, heterosexual man

methods_quotes.q: where MICs are determined via agar dilution.
